_comment: Pins the YOLO weights this commit expects. Weights are NOT in git -- run `python scripts/fetch_models.py` to download them from the GitHub Release named by `release_tag`. Regenerate this file with `python scripts/publish_models.py` after promoting a new model. A model trained by `synth` carries its `recipe` here: `classes` comes from it, and fetching writes it back to `recipe.json` beside the weights.

models.name: Bubbling_final
models.description: Single-mob specialist for Bubbling. Higher precision than `global` on that mob alone.

models.name: PacPinky_final
models.description: Single-mob specialist for PacPinky. Higher precision than `global` on that mob alone.

models.name: global
models.description: General-purpose detector covering the character plus five mobs. This is the default for the training launcher; start here unless you need a single-mob model.
